settings.text:
The Skin Recovery System combines Skinbiotic+ and Dermaboost+ in one dermatologist-formulated daily routine.

Skinbiotic+ supports gut health, microbiome balance, and the gut-skin connection. Dermaboost+ provides broader antioxidant, nutritional, and normal immune support through vitamins, minerals, carotenoids, and botanical polyphenols.

Together, they create a two-step system designed for customers who want to support skin from the gut outward while also strengthening the broader nutritional foundation skin relies on.

The two products begin in different places.

Together they form a gut-to-systemic strategy, with potentially complementary roles across:

settings.note: This section describes formulation rationale. The combined Skin Recovery System has not been established here as a clinically tested finished-product regimen.

settings.heading: Skinbiotic+
settings.subhead: Daily probiotic for gut and skin health
settings.body:
Skinbiotic+ combines organic inulin with multiple probiotic organisms in a synbiotic formula designed around gut health and the gut-skin connection. Its formula includes:

  • Organic inulin
  • Lactobacillus plantarum
  • Bifidobacterium lactis
  • Lactobacillus rhamnosus
  • Bifidobacterium bifidum
  • Akkermansia muciniphila Akk11®

The formulation rationale is the prebiotic and probiotic pairing, and the different ecological roles of the organisms.

Key support areas: gut-skin connection, microbiome balance, synbiotic support, daily internal balance.

settings.heading: Dermaboost+
settings.subhead: Daily immune support for calm, balanced skin
settings.body:
Dermaboost+ combines eight vitamins, minerals, carotenoids, and botanical ingredients selected for broader nutritional, antioxidant, and normal immune-supportive roles. The formula includes:

  • Niacinamide
  • Vitamin D3
  • Vitamin C
  • Zinc
  • Quercetin
  • Curcumin
  • Olive leaf extract
  • Astaxanthin

The formulation rationale identifies several complementary ingredient relationships, including quercetin + curcumin, quercetin + vitamin C, quercetin + astaxanthin, curcumin + olive leaf, and vitamin C + zinc.

Key support areas: antioxidant support, normal immune function, nutritional skin support, daily skin resilience.

settings.heading: The gut and skin are part of a larger system.
settings.body:
The gut-skin axis refers to biological communication between the intestinal environment and the skin. Research in this area looks at pathways involving:

  • Microbial metabolites
  • Intestinal barrier integrity
  • Immune signaling
  • Nutrient metabolism
  • Microbiome composition

Skinbiotic+ is designed around the gut side of that relationship. The gut is one part of the picture; not every skin concern is connected to it.

settings.heading: The microbiome does more than digest food.
settings.body:
Intestinal microorganisms interact with the body through:

  • Metabolites
  • Barrier signaling
  • Nutrient processing
  • Immune communication

Skinbiotic+ supports the microbial environment through prebiotic fiber and multiple probiotic organisms. Dermaboost+ contributes nutrients associated with normal immune physiology.
settings.quote: Supporting normal immune function is not the same as treating an immune-mediated skin condition.

settings.heading: Broader support beyond the microbiome.
settings.body:
Dermaboost+ expands the system beyond gut support through a combination of:

  • Vitamin C
  • Quercetin
  • Curcumin
  • Olive leaf polyphenols
  • Astaxanthin
  • Niacinamide

These ingredients contribute different antioxidant and nutritional roles. The purpose is broader support for the normal biological systems involved in everyday skin resilience.

settings.heading: Is Skin Recovery right for you?
Built to connect the systems skin depends on.
settings.body:
Alchemia MD was created around the idea that skin health is not isolated from the rest of the body.

The Skin Recovery System reflects that philosophy by pairing gut-focused support with broader nutritional and antioxidant support.

The goal is not to treat a condition. It is to create a clearer, more intentional internal skin-health routine.

settings.question: What is the Skin Recovery System?
settings.answer: The Skin Recovery System combines Skinbiotic+ and Dermaboost+ in a two-product daily routine designed to support gut-skin balance together with broader antioxidant, nutritional, and normal immune support.

settings.question: Why are these two formulas paired?
settings.answer: Skinbiotic+ focuses primarily on gut and microbiome support, while Dermaboost+ adds broader antioxidant, nutritional, and normal immune-supportive pathways. Together they form a complementary gut-to-systemic strategy.

settings.question: Is this a treatment for inflammatory skin conditions?
settings.answer: No. The system is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical skin condition.

settings.question: How do I take the system?
settings.answer: Follow each product label. Skinbiotic+: Take one (1) capsule daily with water. Dermaboost+: Take two (2) capsules once daily with water. For enhanced support, take two (2) capsules twice daily with water.

settings.question: Can I buy Skinbiotic+ or Dermaboost+ separately?
Can I subscribe to Skin Recovery?
settings.answer: Yes. The plan options in the purchase box show the currently configured subscription and one-time options.

settings.question: How is this different from Sun Safe?
settings.answer: Sun Safe combines Protect + Balance. Skin Recovery combines Balance + Restore.

settings.question: How is it different from Complete Skin Defense?
settings.answer: Complete Skin Defense contains all three foundational formulas. Skin Recovery contains Skinbiotic+ and Dermaboost+ only.
